name: NATIVE_RISK_V1

accepted_design.name_zh: 源风险约束的原生解剖等变适配
accepted_design.authority: Analysis and complete revision only; no training, no new model forwards/backward, no monitoring or successor launch.

architecture.source_core: Original completed FixMatch43600 EMA163 native backbone/prehead/head frozen in both phases; no new deep supervision heads or posterior solver.
architecture.trainable: Single zero-output residual bottleneck adapter on native prehead h16: h + B_3x3(ReLU(A_1x1 h)); A16->4 fixed random initialization, B4->16 zero initialization, padding1; both A/B trainable, core frozen. All target arms same capacity.
architecture.source_identity: Zero adapter exactly reproduces native source at initialization; learned final adapter is evaluated honestly, no bypass/tag/oracle identity at evaluation.
architecture.deployment: One native pass plus small feature adapter. No blind pixel canonicalizer, image reconstruction, per-image optimization, anatomy head, routing or domain-oracle.
architecture.photometric_transform: Keep V1 fixed invertible intensity/bias family only as a label-preserving training augmentation. No learned blind inverse and no claim of MRI physics recovery.

objective.GT: Unchanged ordinary CE + per-image present-foreground Dice on clean and transformed views, equal mean.
objective.anatomy: Direct native output probability pooled to32/64 versus GT onehot pooled to same scales; mean Jensen-Shannon / ln2, average over resolutions. No learned occupancy classifier, no soft-label entropy floor, full-resolution GT supervision retained.
objective.equivariance: Pixelwise Jensen-Shannon / ln2 between native probabilities on clean and photometric view, spatial coordinates unchanged, both GT supervised.
objective.source_risk_constraints: For each observed source patient x ED/ES x present foreground class, fixed-clean-L group risk CE-on-GT-support + foreground Dice <= same native-initial baseline + .05*max(baseline,.1). Background CE remains in ordinary GT objective. Risks are sampled training surrogates, not validation volume Dice.
objective.risk_optimization: One SGD primal step per batch on L_GT+L_anatomy+L_equivariance+(1/G)sum_g nu_g(R_g-b_g); one projected dual step nu_g<-clip(nu_g+.01*batch_unbiased_group_violation_g,0,10), nu initialized0. For patient/phase/present-class group g, known sampling probability p_g from source/current-L manifests and present-slice cache, unbiased group residual is mean over batch of I_g*(r_slice-b_g)/p_g. Primal uses matching1/(G*p_g) normalization on observed groups. Empty unsupported groups excluded prospectively. No inner solver/extra backward; if dual saturates with violations, report failure, no cap adjustment.
objective.source_reference_cache: Precompute only private scalar per-slice clean-risk baseline on existing230 source train-L slices; no image/logit/feature bank retained for target.
objective.target_constraints: Use only current Philips L reference risks at adaptation entry; S/C share source-F initialization. Constraints protect observed current training groups and cannot certify unseen old-patient retention. Source cache is closed and never read during target.
objective.risk_baseline: Per clean slice and present foreground class r=mean GT-class CE on its GT support + one-vs-rest soft-Dice loss; aggregate over present slices per patient/EDES/class. Cached initial scalar risks and class-presence only; p_g=P(patient)*P(phase)*present_slice_count/phase_depth. No macro-CE replacement of ordinary task, constraints are additional GT-risk controls.

controls.B: Reuse original completed source (no repeat narrow10-patient ordinary source fine-tuning); same zero adapter; current GT-only adaptation.
controls.S: New full-source adapter; current GT-only adaptation.
controls.C: Same new full-source adapter; full native anatomy/equivariance plus current-L risk constraints; sole primary.
controls.fairness: B/S/C share adapter capacity, batches, augmentation, optimizer, steps and accounting; B intentionally has no extra source mechanism training. This budget difference is disclosed. V1 B/F negative results remain and are not relabelled.

source_schedule_proposed.optimizer: SGD lr.001 momentum.9 Nesterov, matrixWD.0005/vector0, globalclip1, fixed2000, EMA.999

source_gate.total_training_stability_formula: Frozen fixed-audit objective L_GT+L_anatomy+L_equivariance+mean positive clean-group risk residual; no time-varying dual multiplier in the audit objective. abs(b-a)/max(1,abs(a))<=.01 for both intervals; component trajectories separately reported. Do not reinterpret V1 sufficiency failure.
source_gate.additional: All source clean-training group constraints checked on all source L once at final EMA with numerical allowance1e-6 on declared loss risk. If violated or audit objective unstable, STOP after complete source evidence; no extension or selecting student/checkpoint.

accepted_design.target_science: Keep original C old absolute>=80.3674066377/new>=83; own and original old-patient CI>=-.30, tails>1<=2/>2=0/p10>=-.50/counts no worse B; C-B new mean+CI>=-.20; C-S new likewise; C-B old>=.30,C-S old>=.15. All conjunction, single seed, repeated-development not independent test.

budget_draft_not_frozen.limits: Original8h/strict4GB/3.5GB pre-stop; cumulative30GB not reset. Independent preflight must bind actual calls/risks/dual-updates and runtime before any run; current draft reserves nothing.

theory.training_groups: If empirical risk constraints are satisfied, each observed training-group surrogate is bounded by its declared baseline plus budget. This is not a bound for held-out patient Dice.
theory.augmentation: JSD(q(x),q(Tx)) encourages invariance only for the specified coordinate-preserving acquisition family. GT task prevents a trivial constant predictor from being free.
theory.residual: Fixed source core and zero adapter preserve exact initial source function; a nonzero adapter can still alter old predictions, so empirical source/old-tail gates remain necessary.
theory.impossibility_limit: No-old-image adaptation plus finite current-L support alone cannot guarantee no forgetting on unseen old inputs. No such guarantee will be claimed.

accepted_design.stop_decision: Only propose this as one complete source-risk-constrained native-output candidate. If prospectively frozen complete validation fails, stop this bundle; no rank/weight/transform-strength/head/EMA/seed local scans.
accepted_design.remaining_before_future_freeze: This is a complete prospective design, not frozen execution authority. If user approves, freeze this exact design and full primitive/data-read/dual-update accounting, then implement and qualify once before any medical run. Do not change thresholds in response to validation.

controls.B: Original completed FixMatch43600 EMA; zero adapter; target GT only
controls.S: New complete source F; target GT only
controls.C: Same source F; full current-L GT/anatomy/equivariance/risk; primary

source_gates: Source capability + fixed training stability + all source train-risk constraints; all required before target baseline/qualification/formal
qualification_fixed_objective: GT+anatomy+equivariance+importance weighted per-slice positive residual upper-surrogate; not time-varying Lagrangian
